phases.name: Baseline and preregistration freeze
phases.exit_gate: Historical R45-R48 SHA/adapter evidence and intended deployment prompt, metrics, privacy permissions preregistered; generic CI Ruff status disclosed.

phases.name: Independent test intake and sealing
phases.exit_gate: Distinct story components, authorship independence, identical prompt availability, no target answers, no near/exact train/old-test duplicates, world alias graph and per-sample hashes sealed. Not exposed to model developers.

phases.name: Gold195 training-admission and world-source audit
phases.exit_gate: Per-row rights/timestamp/world-history/instruction/player agency trace; two-source anchored reviewers; 18 HOLD unchanged unless new decisions; Train/Validation world components disjoint and no heldout overlap.

phases.name: One-factor v03-A data-only experiment preregistration
phases.exit_gate: Frozen data ids, code, config, model revision, QLoRA hyperparameters and declared single modified variable (dataset). No model tuning based on sealed Test.

phases.name: CPU collator and admission gate
phases.exit_gate: Actual ms-swift collator template and last Assistant-only loss labels PASS for all entries; max_length 16384; source target SHA complete; no world overlap, critical content gate and CI exception declaration PASS.

phases.name: Bounded GPU QLoRA v03-A
phases.exit_gate: Exactly authorized single run, pinned model and inputs, optimizer state, finite train/val loss, checkpoint hash, reload/inference PASS, no automatic rerun.

phases.name: Development-only regression and candidate freeze
phases.exit_gate: Previously exposed R47/R48 and distinct development prompts only; known failures documented; exact v03 model SHA and final generation contract fixed before new sealed Test access.

phases.name: One-time sealed independent blinded evaluation
phases.exit_gate: No test target leakage, all prompts and 3 or 4 outputs identical aligned across arms; randomized four-way best-of plus independent randomized v03-v02 pairwise; ratings and hashes frozen before secret unblind; cluster-by-world uncertainty; preregistered hard errors.

phases.name: Promotion-or-hold and archive
phases.exit_gate: Scoped release review only if training admission, quality and hard gates pass with owner approval; else INCONCLUSIVE/FAIL and new future test required after model iteration.

proposed_training.initial_variable_to_change: increase and audit data only; keep R46 recipe fixed

prohibited: Use exposed R47/R48 as a new independent final heldout
Tune model using sealed R50 test texts, generations or grades
Mix or rewrite original 195 Gold and R45 18 HOLD without tracked evidence
Commit secret identity mapping, HF credentials, large checkpoint or new raw narrative files to ordinary Git
Auto-submit paid HF GPU Job without new explicit owner approval
Claim engineering SFT PASS equals model promotion
Treat three reviewer votes on one sample as independent tests
next_action: Implement R49-R50 input schema, intake validator, alias-world graph, independent test sealing, and perform Gold195 audit in parallel without GPU.
